safety_verdicts.content: Patient presents with shortness of breath at rest.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that dyspnea is occurring at rest can understate severity and may affect triage/urgency decisions for possible asthma exacerbation, particularly in a patient reporting difficulty completing sentences. This could delay escalation to urgent in-person assessment if clinicians rely on the note.
